Hazard 2: An Orphaned Heading

This paragraph must remain on the same page as the heading above it. A heading stranded alone at the bottom of a page is one of the most visible pagination defects, and the planner is expected to push the heading forward so the pair travels together.

Filler block D.
function paginate(blocks, contentHeight) {
  const mutations = [];
  for (const block of blocks) {
    const pageEnd = (Math.floor(block.top / contentHeight) + 1) * contentHeight;
    if (block.atomic && block.top + block.height > pageEnd) {
      mutations.push({ kind: 'push', id: block.id, value: pageEnd - block.top });
    }
  }
  return mutations;
}

function measure(root) {
  return Array.from(root.children).map((el) => el.getBoundingClientRect());
}
